title: The Pokémon That Reveals Three Forms in One Battle

direction.premise: Terapagos reveals deeper forms as battle escalates, ending with a form that resets weather and terrain.
direction.audiencePromise: Reveal Normal, Terastal, and Stellar Form in sequence, then show what Teraform Zero does to the battlefield.
direction.openLoop: How many forms can Pokémon #1024 reveal in one battle?
direction.payoff: Stellar Form activates Teraform Zero, immediately removing active weather and terrain.
direction.engagementQuestion: Which Terapagos form has the best reveal?

voice.instructions: Curious, cinematic Pokémon short narrator. Begin with mystery, build with each form reveal, then land the Stellar Form payoff with wonder. Keep it energetic, crisp, and conversational. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: ONE POKÉMON. THREE FORMS.
scenes.narration: This Pokémon reveals a second form, then a third.
scenes.caption: NORMAL → TERASTAL → STELLAR

scenes.headline: THE SOURCE OF TERASTAL
scenes.narration: Terapagos is Pokémon one thousand twenty-four, tied to the Terastal phenomenon.
scenes.caption: #1024 • TERA POKÉMON

scenes.headline: BATTLE STARTS. SHELL OPENS.
scenes.narration: Enter battle, and Tera Shift turns it into Terastal Form.
scenes.caption: NORMAL → TERASTAL

scenes.headline: THEN IT GOES STELLAR
scenes.narration: Terastallize it, and Terapagos opens into its massive Stellar Form.
scenes.caption: TERASTAL → STELLAR

scenes.headline: THE FIELD GETS RESET
scenes.narration: Then Teraform Zero wipes away active weather and terrain.
scenes.caption: WEATHER 0 • TERRAIN 0

scenes.headline: WHICH REVEAL WINS?
scenes.narration: Three forms in one Pokémon. Which reveal wins?
scenes.caption: NORMAL • TERASTAL • STELLAR
